headline: Maui Planning Commission

meeting.summary: The commission backed a lot's rezoning to residential and allowed limited discovery in the Kahana Sunset appeal.
meeting.recap: Item C2 was deferred because six members are needed to act on it.[[0:01:44]] The commission heard a request to change a small lot's zoning from agricultural to R2 residential.[[0:02:01]] The owner said the goal is to fix up the four existing homes, not to add new ones.[[0:08:50]] The owner said the property uses cesspools because County sewer is not available yet.[[0:10:03]] The planning department recommended that the County Council approve the rezoning with no conditions.[[0:22:34]] Commissioners voted to accept that recommendation with five votes.[[0:26:36]] The commission held a prehearing conference on appeals about repairs at Kahana Sunset.[[0:27:22]] The appellants asked for discovery, a process for getting information from other parties before the hearing.[[0:32:16]] The applicant's lawyer said the request covered 14 broad categories with no specific requests.[[0:41:15]] A motion to deny discovery failed on a 3–2 vote.[[1:24:30]] A commissioner moved to allow discovery of the Building A and F applications and related communications, from the County within two weeks.[[2:11:29]] That motion passed with five votes.[[2:16:30]] Staff began part one of a training workshop on planning basics, zoning, and short-term rental and bed-and-breakfast permits.[[2:22:29]] The next regular meeting is November 26.[[4:18:03]]
decided: Item C2 was deferred to the next meeting because six members are needed to act on it.
meeting.next: The commission's rezoning recommendation goes to the County Council, which approves or denies it. The County said it will produce the documents to the commission and the parties within two weeks.

moments.q: Rezoning vote: "that's five votes okay motion carries"
Commission's lawyer explains what discovery is
Chair asks appellants why they did not list specific requests
Director: SMA rules ruled invalid; previous rules apply for now
